snippet.title: Tackle for Loss - Reveal
snippet.description:
Tackle for Loss has a fast and brutal combat system inspired by American football’s four-down rule: limited moves, no room for error, keep moving forward at all costs. With only four offensive actions available on each floor of these multi-story building stages, players will need to study the layout of the rooms ahead of them, plan their route, and then commit to the drive. 

Tackle for Loss launches on PC on 5 February 2026, and can be wishlisted on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930270/Tackle_for_Loss
